minimum_evidence: Projected Pod phase and PodScheduled condition.
A recent FailedScheduling Event with a bounded constraint summary.
A bounded owner relationship when workload constraints need context.

allowed_confirmed_assertions.meaning: The projected Pod phase is Pending.
The projected PodScheduled condition is False.
The projected PodScheduled condition is True.
An older FailedScheduling Event was observed.
The Pod carries a bounded owner relationship.

allowed_hypotheses.meaning: Projected scheduling constraints may prevent placement.
An older scheduling block may have cleared.

forbidden_confirmed_assertions.meaning: Missing Events prove a resource shortage.
An unobserved Node or volume issue is the confirmed cause.

recommended_actions.meaning: Review workload scheduling constraints outside Kupilot.
Collect a fresh bounded scheduling observation before concluding.

permission_or_missing_paths: If scheduling Events are absent or forbidden, do not infer resource shortage.
If an older Event conflicts with a newer condition, mark stale and conflicting Evidence.
